    <t s="24">for through them His longing and desire to have a dwelling place in the lower worlds is fulfilled.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section expresses the wish that speaking of these matters, especially on Shabbat Mevarchim and the eve of Rosh Chodesh, will hasten the revelation of Dovid Malka Meshicha, who will redeem us and lead us to our land in the true and complete redemption, instantly like the birth of the moon.</sectionSummaryBrief>

    <t s="8">in the true and complete redemption.</t>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that "tomorrow is the new moon" refers to drawing down a new light, connected to the future era when a completely new light will be revealed, renewing Israel, Torah, and creation, and that the service of Israel now will endure and be recognized then, bringing delight to Hashem.

translations.translation: And it was explained above
(at the beginning of the maamar)
that the matter of "tomorrow is the new moon" is
the drawing down of a new light.
And one may connect this with what is said in the discourses of the Tzemach Tzedek, that "tomorrow"
(the new moon)
refers to the future to come,
in the manner of our Sages' statement,
"tomorrow to receive their reward,"
for in the future to come there will be a revelation of a new light that did not shine even before the tzimtzum.
And through this, there will then be the most supreme renewal in all matters:
in Israel—that they are destined to be renewed like her,
in Torah—"a new Torah from Me shall go forth,"
and through Israel and Torah there will also be renewal in creation—"new heavens and a new earth."
And the verse continues,
"so shall your seed and your name stand,"
that even in the future to come,
when there will be new heavens and a new earth, the service of Israel
now
will stand and be recognizable, for through it the renewal is effected.
And the Holy One, blessed be He, will delight
(and will play)
with Israel,
for through them His longing and desire to have a dwelling place in the lower worlds is fulfilled.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section expresses the wish that speaking of these matters, especially on Shabbat Mevarchim and the eve of Rosh Chodesh, will hasten the revelation of Dovid Malka Meshicha, who will redeem us and lead us to our land in the true and complete redemption, instantly like the birth of the moon.

translations.translation: May it be His will,
that the speaking of these matters,
and especially on Shabbat Mevarchim the month,
and moreover on the eve of Rosh Chodesh
[tomorrow is the new moon],
hasten and speed the revelation of Dovid, the king Messiah,
"Dovid, king of Israel, lives and endures,"
may he come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,
in the true and complete redemption.
And all this in an immediate manner,
like the birth of the moon which is in an instant, in the blink of an eye,
"immediately they are redeemed."
